title: 化学コンピュータ演習
subtitle: Computer Practice for Chemistry
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) use a personal computer for data analysis in chemistry, engineering (manufacturing). (2) use spreadsheet software to increase the efficiency of data analysis. (3) learn how to solve problems in chemistry and engineering and enhance your understanding of chemistry and engineering. (4) learn the basics of programming utilizing artificial intelligence.
advice: The course will cover: 1. Document preparation, including chemical formulas and crystal structures. 2. Basic knowledge about spreadsheet software, including plotting and visualization of numerical data. 3. Numerical simulations in physical chemistry and chemical engineering. 4. Numerical technique and utilities for finding solutions. 5. Programming in BASIC computer language. Students are expected to bring their personal computer to every class. Be sure that the computer works well before the beginning of the semester. Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class.
requiredKnowledge: Install the specified application (freeware, database access) on your PC before class begins.

activityGoals.body: Prepare a document with chemical structural formulas
Analyze experimental data using a spreadsheet
Explain the basic concepts of programming and data manipulation
Find solutions to problems in physical chemistry and chemical engineering using the PC
Find chemical information using the Internet and a database

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Can prepare well-formed documents with chemical structural formulas. (2) Can correctly perform chemistry and engineering calculations with a PC. (3) Can prepare a useful program in BASIC.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Can prepare documents with chemical structural formulas. (2) Can perform simple calculations in chemistry and engineering using a PC. (3) Can prepare a small program in BASIC.

lessons.assignments: Check your PC and software. Access the Internet and download and install specified freeware.

lessons.content: Drawing of chemical formulas and structural formulas using PC.
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant section of the general or organic chemistry textbook beforehand and be able to do the exercises.

lessons.content: Basic operations of spreadsheet software. Do the exercises of data plotting and visualization with the spreadsheet.
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant section of the physical chemistry textbook beforehand and be able to do the exercises.

lessons.content: Applications for Physical Chemistry 1 (equation of perfect gas, compression factor)
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant section of the physical chemistry textbook beforehand and be able to do the exercises.

lessons.content: Applications for Physical Chemistry 2 (thermodynamics, phase equilibrium)
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant section of the physical chemistry textbook beforehand and be able to do the exercises.
Read the relevant section of the physical chemistry textbook beforehand and be able to do the exercises.

lessons.content: Applications for Physical Chemistry 4 (SI units, dimension analysis, unit conversion, material balance)
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant section of the chemical engineering textbook beforehand and be able to do the exercises.

lessons.content: Applications for Physical Chemistry 5 (chemical equilibrium, reaction kinetics)
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant section of the chemical engineering textbook beforehand and be able to do the exercises.

lessons.content: Advanced use of Excel Spreadsheet 1 (Goal Seek, Solver, Cell functions)
lessons.assignments: Read the materials delivered in the class beforehand and be able to do the exercises.

lessons.assignments: Read the materials delivered in the class beforehand and be able to do the exercises.

lessons.assignments: Read the materials delivered in the class beforehand and be able to do the exercises.

lessons.content: Programming in Excel-VBA 2 (Control structure, loop, judgment)
lessons.assignments: Read the materials delivered in the class beforehand and be able to do the exercises.

lessons.content: Database access and search for scientific information
lessons.assignments: Pick up the relevant topics and keywords from the Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III beforehand and prepare your report on the database search.
Prepare for the final exam and evaluate your understanding.
